observations: Photo 0 is a small, low-resolution picture of a used car engine sitting on a concrete floor in an open-air parts yard, with a wheel hub and other parts nearby.
It looks like a V-type petrol engine with a large black plastic intake manifold on top, hoses and wiring harness attached, and what appears to be a gearbox still bolted on behind it.
No brand badge, engine code or label is readable in photo 0.
Photo 0 carries a dealer watermark reading 'T.I AUTOMOBILE'.
The engine is dusty and used; no cracks are visible at this resolution, and no running, oil or compression evidence is shown.

identity.kind: used car engine (V-type petrol), apparently with gearbox attached
read_from: photo 0: engine visible, no badge or engine code readable

claims.evidence: The engine looks used and possibly imported, but nothing in photo 0 shows its origin, and the seller does not say which engine it is.

risks.risk: The engine make and code are unknown, and engine prices differ widely between models.
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the engine code stamped on the block and any label on the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced; the engine code sets the price.

risks.risk: Engine does not run, has low compression, knocking or a cracked block.
risks.proof: A cold-start running video of this engine on a stand or in a car, plus a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, a core for rebuild.

risks.risk: The gearbox seen behind it may or may not be included, and may not work.
risks.proof: A walkaround clip of all sides of the unit stating what is included.
risks.if_unproven: As the engine only, gearbox not counted.

risks.proof: A walkaround clip showing each ancillary in place.
risks.if_unproven: As a long block without ancillaries.

risks.risk: Internal damage hidden inside, such as sludge or water in the oil.
risks.proof: Photos of the dipstick oil and the underside of the oil filler cap.

proof_requests: A sharp close-up of the engine code stamped on the block.
The make and model of car the engine came from, with a photo of any label on the engine.
A cold-start running video of this engine with a handwritten note bearing today's date in shot.
A walkaround clip of all sides stating whether the gearbox is included.
Photos of the dipstick oil and the oil filler cap underside.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used V-type engine but neither the photo nor the seller says which engine it is, and an engine's price is set by its code, so not even a worst case price is possible until the engine code is shown.
